lines.t: Two hundred and twenty-four million kilometres from Earth, a spacecraft about as tall as a person is falling towards Mars.
To be captured, it must fire its engine at exactly the right moment, and slow down.
Nobody on Earth can help. A radio signal takes twelve and a half minutes to get there.

lines.t: If the burn fails, it flies past Mars, forever.
India becomes the first Asian country to reach Mars, and the first in the world to get there on its very first try.
And the whole mission cost about seventy-four million dollars.
